entities.summary: Burmese, a notable figure in the history of Thailand, associated with Tai Migrations and Early Kingdoms (1200–1558). Preceded by Lan Na and Northern Tai States and Tai Southward Migration. Their legacy influenced King Mangrai founds Chiang Mai as the capital of the Lan Na Kingdom.
